integrity: Proof is self-contained after explicitly identified published arithmetic identities; all quantitative statements justified symbolically; independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The estimate concerns consecutive standard Motzkin numbers modulo five only. No assertion about longer blocks, higher prime powers, or optimal discrepancy. The cited original Lucas congruence and Motzkin identity are antecedents; numerical checking is finite. Novelty is assessed only against inspected literature and database results.
title: Complete consecutive-residue law for Motzkin numbers modulo five
